Every entry states why the file legitimately owns a raw control. `rules` = full exemption for those rules (semantic cases); `counts` = shrinking cap — the file may carry at most that many violations of each listed rule, so additions still fail and removals shrink the debt. Hidden <input type="hidden"> plumbing never needs an entry.
